class NODE[T](value: T) is
    next: NODE[T]?
    previous: NODE[T]?

    insert_after(value: T) -> NODE[T] is
        let inserted = NODE[T](value)

        inserted.previous = self
        inserted.next = next

        if let following = next then
            following.previous = inserted
        fi

        next = inserted

        inserted
    si

    insert_before(value: T) -> NODE[T] is
        let inserted = NODE[T](value)

        inserted.next = self
        inserted.previous = previous

        if let preceding = previous then
            preceding.next = inserted
        fi

        previous = inserted

        inserted
    si

show[T](name: string, node: NODE[T]) is
    let previous = describe(node.previous)
    let next = describe(node.next)

    write_line("{name}: previous {previous}, next {next}")

use IO.Std.write_line

class NODE[T](value: T) is
    next: NODE[T]?
    previous: NODE[T]?

    insert_after(value: T) -> NODE[T] is
        let inserted = NODE[T](value)

        inserted.previous = self
        inserted.next = next

        if let following = next then
            following.previous = inserted
        fi

        next = inserted

        inserted
    si

    insert_before(value: T) -> NODE[T] is
        let inserted = NODE[T](value)

        inserted.next = self
        inserted.previous = previous

        if let preceding = previous then
            preceding.next = inserted
        fi

        previous = inserted

        inserted
    si
si

describe[T](node: NODE[T]?) -> string =>
    if let present = node then "{present.value}" else "none" fi

show[T](name: string, node: NODE[T]) is
    let previous = describe(node.previous)
    let next = describe(node.next)

    write_line("{name}: previous {previous}, next {next}")
si

let first = NODE(1)
let last = first.insert_after(3)
let middle = last.insert_before(2)

show("first", first)
show("middle", middle)
show("last", last)
